description: Strategies that ran the full window and opened no position, examined one by one. Zero trades is only the strategy's own property when nothing on our side prevented it from trading. Where our setup did prevent it, the row is a setup fault and belongs under `open`, not `excluded` - see criterion C3's limit in exclusion_criteria_list.md.
method: probe_zero.py loads the strategy the way freqtrade does, runs populate_indicators and the entry hook over real BTC/USDT data, and counts the rows the entry condition marks. That separates 'the condition is never true' from 'the indicator never got a value'.

zorkv7_0_0.why: Not a zero-trade result - the full-window measurement cannot complete at all, deterministically, on any pair, including BTC/USDT with a full 2020-2026 history. `MadSqueeze` (repos/TheoBrigitte_freqtrade/sources/sponsors/zorkv7_0_0.py:475) calls `sklearn.preprocessing.QuantileTransformer.fit_transform` on a fixed ~10000-row window while the transformer is constructed with `n_quantiles=100000` - sklearn refuses whenever quantiles exceed samples: `ValueError: The number of quantiles cannot be greater than the number of samples used. Got 100000 quantiles and 10000 samples.` Confirmed identical on all eight pairs on the 2026-09-07 profile_full_window.py retry, same traceback every time regardless of the pair's own history length - a fixed parameter mismatch in the strategy's own indicator code, not a resource or per-pair artifact.
zorkv7_0_0.fix: Would require setting n_quantiles to at most the window size (or vice versa) inside MadSqueeze - an edit to the strategy's own logic, not a compat shim restoring something the framework removed. Not attempted; excluded rather than repaired.

Matrix.why: Not a zero-trade result - the full-window measurement cannot complete at all, deterministically, on any pair. `populate_buy_trend` (repair/patched/repos/TheoBrigitte_freqtrade/sources/sponsors/Matrix.py:315) reads `buy_df['coef']`, a column `populate_indicators` never creates - `KeyError: 'coef'`. Confirmed on all eight pairs on the 2026-09-07 profile_full_window.py retry (ADA, BTC, DASH, ETH, LTC, XLM, XMR, XRP/USDT), same traceback every time, so this is not a resource or timing artifact like HarmonicDivergence - it is a straightforward missing-column bug in the strategy's own indicator code.
Matrix.fix: Would require adding the missing `coef` column inside populate_indicators - an edit to the strategy's own logic, not a compat shim restoring something the framework removed. Not attempted; excluded rather than repaired.

HurstCycleV4.why: profile_full_window.py measured all eight configured futures_long pairs (ADA, BTC, DASH, ETH, LTC, XLM, XMR, XRP/USDT:USDT) over the full 2020-2026 window on 2026-09-07; every pair completed and none produced a trade. The one-month smoke test's zero was not a sampling artifact - the strategy genuinely never enters over the full period.
HurstCycleV4.fix: None - this is the strategy's own property, not something to repair.

The one-month smoke test's zero was not a sampling artifact.
LongShortRangeTradingMachetesV1.fix: None - this is the strategy's own property, not something to repair.

The one-month smoke test's zero was not a sampling artifact.

HarmonicDivergence.why: Not a zero-trade result - the full-window measurement cannot complete at all. `add_divergences` (repos/TheoBrigitte_freqtrade/strategies/harmonic-divergence/HarmonicDivergence.py:347) calls `divergence_finder_dataframe`, which appends a full-length `np.empty(len(dataframe['close']))` array to a list once per divergence point found rather than reusing or bounding the buffer. Over the full 6.5-year window this exhausts memory before the run finishes: confirmed on the 2026-09-07 profile_full_window.py retry with `numpy._core._exceptions._ArrayMemoryError: Unable to allocate 1.71 MiB for an array with shape (223998,)` on LTC/USDT and XRP/USDT, and a 1800s timeout (same underlying growth, slower to the same wall) on BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, XLM/USDT, ADA/USDT. Only XMR/USDT (the shortest history of the eight, delisted 2024-02-20) completed, at 0 trades. The defect is in the strategy's own indicator code, not in this audit's setup - unlike BasketStrategy/MostOfAll/FundingCarry below, this is not a setup_fault.
HarmonicDivergence.fix: Would require bounding or reusing the array inside divergence_finder_dataframe - an edit to the strategy's own logic, not a compat shim restoring something the framework removed. Not attempted; excluded rather than repaired.

BasketStrategy.why: The entry condition fires on 8831 of 18570 four-hour candles, so the strategy is not idle. It is a portfolio basket: `custom_stake_amount` sizes each entry as a target weight of the whole portfolio and returns 0.0 when that falls below the exchange minimum. The full-window measurement runs one pair at a time, so there is no basket to take a weight of and every entry is sized to nothing.
BasketStrategy.fix: Measure it across all eight pairs in one run, as its author intended, rather than pair by pair.

MostOfAll.why: `data['final_ub'].iat[i] = ...` raises ChainedAssignmentError under pandas Copy-on-Write: the assignment silently updates a copy, so the supertrend bands never leave their initial values and `most` never crosses `exma`. The author's pandas performed that assignment.
MostOfAll.fix: The same route as the other dtype_drift rows: an in-place assignment through `.loc`, or an older pandas. Not attempted yet.

FundingCarry.why: The entry needs `funding_z`, built from funding rates, which exist only in futures mode. The row was run under `spot_long`, where the feature can never be satisfied.
FundingCarry.fix: Run it under a futures profile with funding-rate data.

Insomnia_short.why: The strategy sets `enter_long = 0` and only ever raises `enter_short`. `can_short` is not set, so freqtrade discards every short signal and nothing is left.
Insomnia_short.fix: Run it with `can_short` enabled under a futures profile.

ep3mas2.why: The entry requires four rolling comparisons and a crossover to hold at once. Over 30000 five-minute candles the conjunction is never true, and the full-window run over eight pairs and six and a half years found the same. No error, no missing indicator - the condition is simply never met.

BreakEven.why: `dataframe.loc[..., 'buy'] = 0`. The entry is hard-wired off; the file demonstrates stop-loss handling.

MyStrategyTemplate.why: A template shipped with a beginners' tutorial, with no condition filled in.

ViN.why: `df.loc[:, 'buy'] = False` in the last of five entry hooks overrides everything the earlier ones set.

Miku_PP_v3.why: The probe cannot evaluate it outside a backtest - `populate_indicators` calls `self.dp.get_pair_dataframe` for a daily timeframe, and there is no DataProvider outside freqtrade. Its own full-window run did have one and still opened nothing, so the measured result stands.

Obelisk_3EMA_StochRSI_ATR.why: Same as Miku_PP_v3: `if not self.dp:` at the top of `populate_indicators` puts it out of the probe's reach. The full-window run had a DataProvider and still opened nothing.
